description: This class acts as a command handler for creating notes within the Fineract system. It implements the NewCommandSourceHandler interface and delegates the creation logic to the NoteWritePlatformService.

classes.name: CreateNoteCommandHandler
classes.description: A service class that handles 'create note' commands by implementing the NewCommandSourceHandler interface and calling the note creation service.

methods.name: CreateNoteCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the handler with the NoteWritePlatformService dependency.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the command by delegating to the NoteWritePlatformService to create a note.
